S.FORM: alang Lacihakan ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Hamicho go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 197 buwan, 497 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 53% kyan ku 262 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 47% kyan ku 235 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 51%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Lacihakan hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Lacihakan hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Lacihakan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Lacihakan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Lacihakan hya' ga Olaw. tay mkyahu' na Lacihakan hya' ga Olalip. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Lacihakan ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Lacihakan ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu ħami[ʦ|ʨ]ħo ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ħjaʔ ɣa olaw taj mkjaħuʔ na la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ħjaʔ ɣa olalip reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ la[ʦ|ʨ]iħakan ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
